Briefing · Overview

OVERVIEW

Built to enumerate and monitor linear plantations at provincial scale, the LTE platform combines interactive geospatial visualization with optimized spatial querying so field and admin users can track millions of records without performance loss.

  • Next.js
  • NestJS
  • PostgreSQL
  • PostGIS
  • Leaflet
  • CI/CD
HIGHLIGHTS
  • Interactive map rendering with layered overlays
  • High-performance spatial queries on large datasets
  • Role-based access across government hierarchy
  • QR-based geospatial tagging of records
